summary: The ep-65 regression is a FALSE positive: ep 65 (2008-01-12) is correct and the typo is on ep 64. REBORN! aired weekly Saturdays on TV Tokyo and skipped 2007-12-29, so 標的63 (12-22) is followed by 標的64 on 2008-01-05. Both ja-WP (2008年 放送リスト) and en-WP's season-2 table give 標的64 怒りの真相 = 2008-01-05 and 標的65 決着! = 2008-01-12.

repairs.why: Ep 64 'The Truth Behind The Rage' (怒りの真相) aired 2008-01-05 (the first Saturday after the 2007-12-29 New Year skip). ja-WP 各話リスト 2008年 and en-WP 'Reborn! season 2' both give January 5, 2008. Stored 2008-01-18 is not even a Saturday and is what produced the ep-65 regression; ep 65 (2008-01-12), ep 66 (01-19) and ep 67 (01-26) are correct.

structure.notes: 203 rows; ja-WP numbers episodes 標的1..203 continuously and matches our numbering in this zone (標的63 = our ep 63).
